create_base_config: create a TRL _BaseConfig dataclass that subclasses TrainingArguments with custom defaults
configure_logging_steps: configure logging_steps as integer or float ratio for TRL trainer logging intervals
enable_gradient_checkpointing: enable gradient_checkpointing to trade compute for memory in TRL training
setup_bf16_precision: setup bf16 mixed precision with automatic fp16 fallback in TRL _BaseConfig
configure_liger_kernel: configure use_liger_kernel to enable Liger Kernel optimizations for multi-GPU throughput
